summary.text: Annie Spell is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 45, representing Lafayette, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2025 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Annie Spell's occupation as Business Owner and Child Psychologist.

It lists Annie Spell's education as High School Diploma, Academy of the Sacred Heart in Grand Coteau, LA; B.S., Psychology, University of Louisiana at Lafayette; M.S. and Ph.D., Clinical Psychology, Louisiana State University; M.S., Psychopharmacology, Alliant International University.
The House member page lists Annie Spell's committee assignments as Health and Welfare; Retirement; Transportation, Highways and Public Works; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
